newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES EDGE SLIGHTLY UP ON TAX PAYMENTS.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES EDGE SLIGHTLY UP ON TAX PAYMENTS.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates finished slightly higher on Tuesday as social security contribution and general sales tax (GST) payments around July 20 reduced market liquidity, dealers said.
"Relatively large amounts have been paid as GST," said Karoly Barath of Postabank.
The overnight rates ended at 20.25/20.375 percent, up from Monday's close of 20.125 percent.
Dealers said funds were likely to flow in one-week reverse repo deals with the central bank at 20 percent.

They added that the market did not expect repo rate cuts for the near future, especially because June's 18.7 percent year-on-year inflation figure published recently showed an unexpected rise which analysts regarded as temporary.
Dealers said market liquidity was likely to improve later this week.
"We may go back to 20.125 or even 20 percent in one or two days," Barath said.
